rows.action: 교정 중단·재활성화·Replay 후 현재 값과 provenance를 확인한다.
rows.observed: Three domains are corrected through the existing Correction journal in all three storage modes: a taste (preferences) and a boundary on separate character targets, and a promise (narrative thread). Each is applied, suspended (the original value returns and no active provenance remains), reactivated (the corrected value and provenance return), and replayed (rebuild keeps the corrected value; no model call). The canonical record's facts/entities/bindings and its artifactDigest are unchanged, and provenance records the real canonical cursor (memoryId/revision/artifactDigest/turnRange) under policy point_in_time_override, keeping the correction id distinct from the source event it is anchored to.
